findings.finding: Sidebar CSS aliases and Tailwind colors are undefined; browser background is transparent, selected state has no semantic surface.
Input/menu/submenu/action/skeleton sizes and focus differ from shared controls; default inset carries shadow.
Translucent blur and forced descendant styles override semantic highlighted/destructive menu states.
Dark input surface uses border color tint and questionnaires shrink to32px instead of common input surface/40px.
Navigation control size, open/focus rules and10px layout rhythm drift from shared rules.
Table/toolbar recipes force shared Button and Select to32px.
Nonfloating table/platform shadow and16px panel radius diverge from Card rules.
Interactive chart24px/32px insets and custom Select radius drift from common Card20px/control8px.
Drawer uses palette black while dialog uses semantic backdrop; Tooltip inverted colors diverge from documented popover surface.
Registry install lost dynamic asChild; explicit render preserves one menu button; mobile Sheet width clamps correctly
Tooltip semantic popover/typography and current Cartesian/polar tick selectors restore text contrast
Inline-size containers and horizontal fields preserve input/label width
Relative table scroll wrappers contain absolute sr-only labels and avoid document overflow
External navigation uses reserved responsive gutters
Detach via ref(null) removes duplicate motion controllers; per-property completion restores caller styles and theme semantics; markers share Checkbox/Radio boundary contrast
Compact action rows remain centered after mobile wrapping
Radar labels have space; custom/radius/radial values use semantic foreground with appropriate surface backing
Common focus uses40% and ordinary choice/toast surfaces12px

exceptions.reason: Large page headings/photography/section spacing describe marketing hierarchy; do not force product control/title geometry.

exceptions.scope: Avatar, Calendar, chart geometry and canvas object colors
exceptions.reason: Avatar/media/compact day cells/series are not general action controls. Object data colors describe app content, not brand/status tokens.
exceptions.reconsiderWhen: Interactive hit area or semantic meaning becomes unclear

exceptions.reason: Raised surfaces may use semantic shadow to indicate overlay depth.

exceptions.scope: Chart plot geometry and marketing/media content
exceptions.reason: Data series, media assets and intentional marketing hierarchy keep their roles; text contrast and clipping still require fixes
exceptions.reconsiderWhen: Any semantic label becomes unreadable or content/control exits viewport

exceptions.reason: It temporarily overlays a scroll boundary; actual scroll and jump reveal all body copy and final content
exceptions.reconsiderWhen: Body copy cannot be reached or read after scrolling

exceptions.scope: Animated helper output and native media/clipboard
exceptions.reason: Native media error/reset UI and copy success were verified; exact clipboard bytes and successful external video playback are outside current artifact evidence
exceptions.reconsiderWhen: The component changes media or clipboard API behavior
